title: Basic katakana: Vowels and K row — write in kana
description: Use Latin-letter syllable cues to recall and type the matching katakana signs. Kana answers only; no sign is displayed in the question.

review.provenance: Independent agent-authored katakana sign cues and feedback; no CSV or mock text reused.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-authored English copy and glosses; katakana correspondences are linguistic facts. No third-party text or audio used.

exercises.prompt: From the Latin-letter spelling cue below, recall and type its katakana sign (not romaji).

stimulus.translation: Latin-letter cue for the basic katakana a sign.

text.gloss: Katakana sign for the basic a reading.

exercises.explanation: The katakana spelling for written a is ア. Katakana sign for the basic a reading. Only the authored katakana spelling is accepted; hiragana is not an alias.
